system.tactics: Giant Squids attack from below, opening with Ink Cloud before separating a vessel's crew. They grapple swimmers and drag them away from rescue, then use the Beak on anyone who closes. They flee if badly wounded unless defending a nest or wreck.
system.attacksNotes:
Tentacle [Combat]: Melee attack (Agil 7 + Melee Combat 7), Reach: 20 ft

  • Margin 1:: 16 damage (10 + 6 Str)
  • Margin 2: 16 damage, DR halved (round up); target is Grappled

Beak [Combat]: Melee attack (Agil 7 + Melee Combat 7), Reach: 5 ft

  • Margin 1:: 18 damage (12 + 6 Str)
  • Margin 2: 18 damage, DR halved (round up)

Multiattack [Combat]: The Giant Squid makes four Tentacle ### Attacks against up to four targets. It cannot make a Beak attack during the same action. Shared Attribute Roll (Agil 4): Roll Agility once and apply it to all four ### Attacks.
system.specialAbilitiesNotes: Ink Cloud (Recharge 5-8) [Combat]: The Giant Squid releases a cloud in a 30-foot radius. The area becomes heavily obscured for 1 minute, and the squid may immediately Hide without cover. The cloud disperses in strong current or after the squid leaves it. Crushing Grip: A creature Grappled by a Tentacle takes 6 bludgeoning damage at the start of the squid's turn. A creature can escape with a Hard Athletics check. Aquatic Body: The Giant Squid can breathe water indefinitely. On land, it moves at half speed and adds 1 to both attack dice. Action Points (3): Boss template. Spend at the end of any other creature's turn: Move (1, up to half speed), Attack (1, no Multiple Action Penalty), Detect (1), Special Ability (2). Regains all at the start of its own turn.
